actual.renderedCopyTranscription:
Your Papercusp utility

The psu + pui utility download was requested. You can download it again below if needed.

The next page takes you to the GUI, but you may prefer to drive your agents from psu. It wraps Claude Code, Codex and OMP with your context, memory, documentation, Papercusp tools and prompts so you can steer a coordinated agent factory.

You can run the local server to keep agents and data on your machine, use managed cloud where Papercusp handles the cloud account and billing for a flat monthly rate, or bring your own cloud account while Papercusp provisions the machines and you retain control of your data.

Download psu + pui again
Continue to GUI

Windows uses the Linux package through WSL2. On macOS, choose Apple Silicon or Intel on the download page.
